# S351 — Landing commits the owner's uncommitted edits on main into its tracking commit

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**2026-11-18** — Owner decision 2026-11-18: adj 483 landing.tracking-commit-scope = pause (narrows adj 193).

trust: unverified; by: Jon Robbins

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Observed 2026-11-12 (slicer s451 landing): the outer session had uncommitted filings on main (s457 spec, s459 decision) awaiting the owner's commit approval; ork's landing committed them as part of "Tracking edits on main before landing s451" (f18adb3b and the merge) without asking. Wanted: commit only the landed slice's own tracking edits, and refuse or pause on other uncommitted changes on main, naming them.

Evidence (2026-11-18):

- slicer commit f18adb3b ("Tracking edits on main before landing s451", 2026-11-12) holds one file, `.slicer/render/slices/s459.md`: another item's render, dirty on main, that the s451 branch also changed (`git -C ../slicer show --stat f18adb3b`).
- This is the decided behaviour. adj 193 (`landing.tracking-commit`, decided `commit-tracking`, S254): before the merge-in, ork commits every dirty tracking file on main that the slice branch also changes. `checkMain` (`internal/engine/landdirty.go:162-188`) takes the overlap from `dirtyOverlap` (`:31-58`), keeps `.slicer/` paths except `config.json` and `relay-roles.json` (`trackingPath`, `:80-88`), and commits them by literal path (`commitLiteralPaths`, `:196-230`). Called twice per landing (`internal/engine/land.go:65`, `:80`).
- The launch commit already limits itself to the item's own files plus the index (`commitLaunchTracking`, `internal/engine/landdirty.go:107-158`; adj 295, adj 321). The landing commit has no such limit.
- Shared tracking files (`.slicer/index.json`, `.slicer/log.jsonl`, `.slicer/render/ROADMAP.*`) always mix the slice's and the owner's edits, so "only the slice's own edits" cannot split them; only whole files can be left out.
- The owner can commit pending filings with `ork tracking commit` (adj 453, `cli.tracking-commit`) before `ork retry`.

Decided: adj 483 (`landing.tracking-commit-scope` = pause) narrows adj 193. The landing pauses and names another item's slice file or render, and keeps committing the item's own and shared tracking files.
